entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Shravan Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
The FIR in question was lodged as missing person report.
Subsequently, in the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim has not supported the prosecution story.

During trial also,
the victim did not support the prosecution story.

3. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
Gadami @ Saddam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

entities.text: Gadami @ Saddam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the statements of the victim coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 16.06.2021 and has no criminal antecedents, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
5. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Gadami @ Saddam be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.0144 of 2021,
under Sections 363, 366, 376, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act, Police Station Hasanganj, District Unnao on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable local sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023 akverma  Gadami @ Saddam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137280902/
